steps.content: She treks through the steep cliffs and icy mountains.
Then crosses the boundless plains and winding rivers.
After overcoming endless dangers, Lynn finally finds the candy of courage. This is the moment where her wish can come true—she can finally gain courage.
In this moment, the candy that can save the world sits quietly in Lynn's palm, but she can't eat it.
It's because tears are uncontrollably pouring out of her eyes.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: It's too late... Even if I gain courage now, it's useless...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I looked for excuses every time... Even this candy is an excuse...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I know full well... that I'm just scared to face the Archdemon...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Everyone has been encouraging me and trying to help me flee, even if it meant sacrificing themselves... Yet I...

steps.speaker: Villager
steps.content: Don't mind us, Lynn! Go find the candy! You must take care of yourself!

steps.speaker: Villager
steps.content: You can do it, Lynn!

steps.speaker: Villager
steps.content: Go! You must find the candy of courage! You are our hope!

steps.speaker: Villager
steps.content: We're all depending on you!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Even if I gain courage and defeat the Archdemon... What's the point...
As Lynn wallows in sorrow, a dark shadow sneaks up on her.
By the time she notices it, it's too late. The dark shadow had already snatched the candy of courage from her hand in one swipe.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe! Oh brave heroine, now's not the time to be sad!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: All your courage belongs to me now!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: You... How did you...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Following you all this time was worth it! Now I can get rid of my only threat, and that's—you!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Owoo.
The Archdemon swallows the candy in one gulp.
As if the whole ordeal had been too easy, the Archdemon shifts her nonchalant gaze to the villagers.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: As punishment for you running away, I'm now going to eat all the villagers!
OwO the Archdemon cackles arrogantly. It's a familiar scene all over again.
Time after time of being helpless. Time after time of failing.
The best chances have all been lost to cowardice.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hahahaha! Without the candy of courage, how are you going to defeat me?
The Archdemon taunts the girl, trying to crush her last ray of hope...
The girl doesn't flinch. She wipes away her tears and stares directly at the so-called "Archdemon" in front of her.
She finally made her decision—to challenge what she fears most.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I won't let you...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I won't let you harm the villagers anymore!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I've fled too many times already... This time, I won't flee again!
She didn't have the "candy of courage" that can save the world and defeat the Archdemon.
But for the first time, she mustered the courage to face the Archdemon.
